text:
Ana Rivera: quick follow-up to pipeline RFC: propose an edge 'slimbridge' that strips high-cardinality attrs but preserves a stable billing_key and optional attr_ref for later enrichment.
CJ Park: doable. must standardize canonical keys and derive billing_key deterministically at edge.
Michael Li: tradeoffs: late-join correctness and reduced debuggability when attrs are pruned.
Ana Rivera: sketch: emit envelope {billing_key, minimal_meta, attr_ref?}; POST full attrs to enrichment-cache TTL=48h when route flagged.
Sara Gupta: sampling interaction: if sampling occurs after pruning we lose attribution. either sample at edge or emit attr_ref so enrichment can fetch attrs for late samples.
CJ Park: attr_ref hdr: x-attr-ref = sha256(trace_id + ts). store in enrichment-cache only for billing-sensitive traces.
Michael Li: risk: cache key explosion. mitigate with TTL, LRU, and predicate to only store for ~10% of traces.
Sara Gupta: billing_key rule: tenant_billing_id if present else sha256(tenant_id + '|' + route) computed at edge before pruning.
Ana Rivera: edge agent pseudocode:
```
if has(tenant_billing_id): billing_key = tenant_billing_id
else: billing_key = sha256(tenant_id + '|' + route)
if route in billing_sensitive_routes:
  attr_ref = sha256(trace_id + now())
  enrichment_cache.put(attr_ref, full_attrs, ttl=48h)
  emit_envelope(billing_key, attr_ref, minimal_meta)
else:
  emit_envelope(billing_key, null, minimal_meta)
```
CJ Park: security: store must be KMS-encrypted and RBAC-protected. enrichment workers fetch with service account.
Sara Gupta: fallback if cache unavailable: emit full_attrs (costly) or mark trace as degraded and use safe fallback routing.
Michael Li: reuse existing enrichment-cache service to avoid ops burden; need to model storage.
Ana Rivera: rough calc: 1KB * 1M traces/day * 10% => ~100GB/day, 48h => 200GB hot. CJ to validate.
CJ Park: I'll run capacity numbers and post spreadsheet. add per-route feature toggle for rollout.
Sara Gupta: rollout: canary 1% low-risk routes 24h; monitor billing delta and "attr-missing" errors.
ingest-bot: created checklist item #3124 for edge-slimbridge-gate (assignee: CJ Park).
Ana Rivera: actions: CJ -> numbers + PR; Michael -> cache reuse spike; Sara -> SLIs + canary; me -> RFC update. target: feature-flag in 2 sprints.
